name: Transformar
description:
You attempt to morph into a near-exact copy of a creature or object you can see in range. For the duration, you copy the target's type, ability scores, AC, skills, save proficiencies, speeds, senses, size, abilities, and current moves. You retain your own feats, level, and HP. A change in CON does not impact your HP.

If you attempt to transform into a pokémon, the base SR of the target must be able to be controlled by your trainer or the move fails. If you attempt to transform into an object, the object must be able to fit within a 10-foot Cube.

While transformed, you may use a bonus action to dismiss the transformation. Additionally, transformation automatically ends when you reach 0 HP or return to a pokéball.

updated.details: Lasts longer without concentration, and can copy objects.
